name: BitterSweet: Zhentan Cha Hui
source:
Elaine seeks the help of detective to investigate a fire in her childhood home.
She suspects Beneatha - a mysterious thief vanished six years ago - is the arsonist.

As they embark on a journey to track down her past thefts,
they encounter a series of murders…
Are all of these related…?

[from [url=https://consteria.itch.io/bittersweet-detectives-tea-party]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊莲向侦探求助，希望调查童年故居发生的火灾。
她怀疑，六年前消失的神秘大盗贝妮莎，就是纵火者。

在追查她过去盗窃案件的旅途中，
一连串谋杀案接踵而至…
这一切，都有所关联吗…？

[摘自[url=https://consteria.itch.io/bittersweet-detectives-tea-party]itch.io[/url]]
